## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A/B coordination. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.

Goal: reduce review overhead by landing existing follow-up commits once in owning PRs. Wait for zaq-emb.21.1 email-regression owner in merry-iguana to finish/commit #799; do not edit its reserved paths or switch its branch. Incorporate #803 (618deb6ff capability lookup) and #804 (6ded08f75 queued-webhook guard) into PR #799 along with the independent email fix. Incorporate #802 (55863669f executor) into PR #800. Reconcile differing commit ancestry by rebase/merge with backup refs; never overwrite uncommitted changes or deferred stashes. Preserve only communication UI; no data-source card changes. Validate each resulting PR branch independently with isolated regression/notification suites plus mix q; final precommit deferred. Update GH PR descriptions and stack bases as needed so duplicate fixes occur once; coordinate before any force push, do not merge/close superseded PRs without explicit user approval. Action reuse: no new domain operations (Git/PR housekeeping only); existing fixes reused unchanged. No new application code, migrations or docs expected; test regressions inherited from source commits. Record before/after commit graph and verification in issue.

After: PR799 includes email fix 59f5eca26 + cherry-picks 397f4e52f (#803) and 036b64078 (#804), head 036b64078; PR800 includes executor cherry-pick 9d42e8786 (#802), merged new PR799 ancestry ee4f26be2, head ee4f26be2. PR799 focused branch run 831 tests/2 properties/0 failures; PR800 691 tests/11 properties/6 doctests/0 failures; mix q and git diff --check passed separately, pre-push hooks passed. GH get_files verifies PR799 changed 56 paths (Channels api/bridge/JidoConnectBridge but no data-source ProviderLive); PR800 changed 47 paths (Executor but no connector guard duplications). PR descriptions updated; micro PR802-804 clearly marked SUPERSEDED DO NOT MERGE but left open per prior user constraint, awaiting explicit closure approval. Both owning PRs remain open drafts; no merge or final feature approval. Other regression session in merry-iguana notified and paused; both worktrees clean. Deferred stash snapshots untouched.

PR #800 conflict repair authorized by user. Preserve HEAD 8f4e6b22 and merge updated #799 tip 3a47ca63 without rewriting history. Resolved channels/engine documentation by retaining history foundations; retained StubConversations in both router-test conflict hunks. All three resolved files exactly match pre-merge HEAD. Action reuse: not applicable — Git ancestry repair, no new executable operations. mix q passed; focused router/executor/person-merge regressions: 82 tests, 3 properties, zero failures. Next: final validation and downstream merge compatibility checks.

Completed PR #800 base repair: pushed ancestry-preserving merge 35e20f80 (parents 8f4e6b22 and updated #799 3a47ca63). No force push. All six downstream PR heads (#806, #807, #808, #811, #812, #813) merge cleanly with repaired #800 via git merge-tree simulations. mix q and focused regressions passed; final mix precommit passed: 48 doctests, 184 properties, 9931 tests, zero failures, 1 skipped and 100 excluded. No new feature behavior or E2E scope; conflict hunks preserve existing #800 docs/test setup. Commit and push hooks passed.

User authorized coordinated rebase repair after #799 moved to 0ef9ed87. Snapshot remote stack: #800 35e20f80; #806 bc7c1b03; #807 fefb5d7e; #808 ab9331ad; #811 ba355624; #812 d775e9eb; #813 7ba7933a. git cherry confirms only eba6d105, 9d42e878, 0d739ccd are unique to #800; old connector commits are patch-equivalent duplicates. Plan: backup all tips; rebase #800-only work onto frozen #799; compare resulting tree to expected three-way integration; replay each descendant relative to saved old parent; validate each tree/diff and affected regressions; publish atomically with explicit force-with-lease checks. Action reuse: not applicable — history maintenance only.

Coordinated rebase repair completed and atomically pushed with explicit force-with-lease for all seven refs. #799 held at 0ef9ed87; new heads #800=1fb547a0, #806=fb29ecc4, #807=be72ed82, #808=540efc34, #811=045d18e4, #812=c646057d, #813=b2b17ca0. Removed patch-equivalent old connector commits from #800 replay; retained three unique commits plus explicit router admission-setup commit previously hidden in merge resolutions. #800 tree exactly equals expected three-way integration (2e317e7e); every downstream binary incremental diff is unchanged. Local branch refs aligned; previous remote and local tips retained under backup/stack-800-20260929/*. No changes to #799 or integration worktree. mix q passed on #800 and final stack; #800 focused tests: 86 tests/5 properties/0 failures. Final-stack precommit initially hit LLMPerformanceFailureTest telemetry fallback flake; isolated rerun passed and complete precommit rerun passed: 10026 tests, 192 properties, 48 doctests, zero failures, 1 skipped/100 excluded. GitHub confirms all seven PRs MERGEABLE (other required checks remain BLOCKED). Worktree clean on #800. Future restacks should use saved old-parent tips with rebase --onto and proceed bottom-up; avoid replaying obsolete merged connector ancestry.
